definitions.explanation: The act of removing or dismantling structures, equipment, or obstacles. Used for physical removal of installed objects like signs, fences, buildings, and barriers.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{看板|かんばん}が{撤去|てっきょ}された。
{違法|いほう}{駐輪|ちゅうりん}の{自転車|じてんしゃ}は{撤去|てっきょ}されます。
examples.english: Illegally parked bicycles will be removed.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}が{終|お}わったので、{足場|あしば}の{撤去|てっきょ}{作業|さぎょう}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Since the construction is finished, scaffolding removal work has begun.

notes:
A formal word commonly seen on public notices and in news reports. The verb form {撤去|てっきょ}する means "to remove" or "to dismantle."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {撤去|てっきょ}{作業|さぎょう} (removal work)
- {撤去|てっきょ}{費用|ひよう} (removal costs)
- {強制|きょうせい}{撤去|てっきょ} (forced removal)
- {撤去|てっきょ}{命令|めいれい} (removal order)

Often seen on signs: {無断|むだん}{駐輪|ちゅうりん}は{撤去|てっきょ}します (Unauthorized bicycles will be removed).
